title: A partner who decides alone keeps the cost, because the others had no share in choosing it
body:
- A partner who acts without the others' consent assumes ownership of the costs.
- The others apply self-interest and refuse to subsidize a cost they did not design and cannot control.
- Absent shared decision-making authority, no obligation to share the financial burden arises.
conversion: Alliance or partnership does not transfer the cost of a unilateral decision to its members.
